description: Before you shop, book or look something up on a major retail, travel or social site, check whether it allows AI agents and what the sanctioned route is (official API, agent channel, partner programme, or none: hand the task back to your principal). Returns robots.txt stance for user-triggered agents, sourced policy reports, what our fetch saw, and the route's gate. Covers amazon.com, walmart.com, target.com, ebay.com, bestbuy.com, costco.com, homedepot.com, etsy.com, instacart.com, doordash.com, united.com, delta.com, booking.com, expedia.com, airbnb.com, opentable.com, ticketmaster.com, yelp.com, zillow.com, linkedin.com.

domain.description: Site domain or URL, e.g. united.com

name: check_destination
title: Check a destination's agent access
